desc: 一面学习一面拼搭，桌腿分档增高，桌面够大带收纳位
leaf: 儿童双面颗粒积木桌（一面光滑学习面、一面拼搭颗粒面，桌腿可分档增高，带收纳位）
name: 双面颗粒儿童积木桌款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清这是一张带颗粒拼搭面的积木桌，而不是散装积木或普通小书桌，抢点击并满足白底主图合规。
详情页首屏承接主图，用青绿大字加四个杏黄线性图标位把一桌多用的核心理由一次摊开，让人决定继续往下滑。
shots.textZone: small-caps kicker and quoted headline in the upper half, a row of four apricot icon cards under the headline

shots.intent: 把在小板面上拼不开、拼一半全散掉这个真实烦扰放大，再用同一屏的满桌面积给出解决姿态，制造继续看的动机。
shots.textZone: quoted headline strip across the top, one short label centered under each panel

shots.intent: 把这张桌最核心的差异机制一次讲清：一面平整可写画、一面颗粒可拼搭，两块色板对应两张实物图，替代空洞形容词。
shots.textZone: headline block centered above the split, one label pair sitting on each tilted colour field

shots.intent: 把同一张桌在不同腿长配置下的三种高度形态并排展示，让买家用肉眼完成选款与使用年限判断，而不是靠文案承诺。
shots.textZone: one apricot label chip under each of the three builds, headline above the row

shots.intent: 用微距让颗粒间距与砖块咬合状态自己说话，回答拼得上、拼得稳、容不容易掉这个最关键的疑虑。
shots.textZone: one circle-ringed caption window at the lower right holding a single short label

shots.intent: 把边缘倒角和桌面以下收纳结构这两个做工点单独放大，让人看到厚度和处理方式，替代表面形容词。
shots.textZone: two thin callout rules leaving the frame edge to labels on the right, one vertical label column

shots.intent: 让家长代入有人陪玩、玩得开的真实画面，同时用实物尺度说明桌子高度与桌面面积怎么用。
shots.textZone: one short label chip in the lower right corner

shots.intent: 收掉下单前的信息缺口：用青绿描边圆角卡片把名称、配件、规格三项一次摊清，把不确定变成可核对。
shots.textZone: three stacked cards, each with a teal field name and one placeholder value line, headline above the grid

shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏收口，用成品搭好的桌面和一个明确动作把看完的犹豫转成加购。
shots.textZone: headline field on the white card above the table, rounded CTA button below the headline

style.backgroundSystem: flat mint #A9E2DC fields carrying one soft diagonal light-leak band, alternating with #FFFFFF and #F6F8F7 panels; information lives in rounded-rectangle cards with a 24px corner radius and a 2px #14939B outline; product photos are cropped into hexagon or circle windows ringed by a thin #14939B double outline; never a photographic backdrop behind an infographic screen
style.direction: fresh minimal kids furniture-and-play ecommerce, cool mint infographic system built on rounded info cards and photo windows
style.iconSystem: single-weight 2px #14939B line pictograms centered inside #F8CD93 rounded squares or thin-outlined circles, small solid #F8CD93 triangle arrow markers and short thin rules for callouts; no filled emblems, no seals, no certificate artwork, no mascot illustration
style.lightingSystem: bright cool high-key daylight around 6000K from the upper front-left, soft wraparound fill from the opposite side, gentle neutral contact shadows, flat commercial mood, no warm cast, no dramatic falloff, no coloured gels
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh minimal kids play-furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mint field #A9E2DC, clean white panel #FFFFFF, teal display ink #14939B and apricot info block #F8CD93, with off-white #F6F8F7 panels and #2B2B2B small-caps ink; cool high-key daylight tone; one heavy geometric sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin, headlines 32-48pt solid #14939B flanked by a pair of #F8CD93 quote marks, sublines 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt, a wide-tracked small-caps Latin kicker above each headline and a three-dot #F8CD93 separator below it; background system of flat mint #A9E2DC fields with one soft diagonal light-leak band alternating with #FFFFFF and #F6F8F7 panels, rounded-rectangle info cards at 24px corner radius with a 2px #14939B outline, hexagon and circle photo windows ringed by a thin #14939B double outline; lighting system of bright cool high-key daylight near 6000K from the upper front-left with soft wraparound fill and gentle neutral contact shadows, never warm, never dramatic; surface system of matte #FFFFFF seamless, pale #EDEFEA tabletop and light #D9E7E4 floor; icon system of single-weight 2px #14939B line pictograms inside #F8CD93 rounded squares and thin-outlined circles with small #F8CD93 triangle markers; tabletop panel geometry, stud grid pitch, corner radius, leg profile and pastel brick colour mix always true to the reference and identical across screens, stable product scale, no floating product without a contact shadow, no identifiable child face; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no QR codes, no store badges, no membership copy, no watermark.

style.typography: one heavy geometric sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin; headlines 32-48pt solid #14939B flanked by a pair of #F8CD93 typographic quote marks, sublines 16-20pt in #2B2B2B, labels 10-14pt, a small-caps wide-tracked Latin kicker above each headline and a three-dot #F8CD93 separator under it; all rendered copy is a short 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」 placeholder, per-screen budget under 40 characters
